punchline: Sweet bought the house alone, but an organisation carried the case.
thirty_sec: In 1925 Dr Ossian Sweet moved into a house in a white Detroit neighbourhood. A shot from the house killed a man, and all eleven people inside were charged with murder. The NAACP took the case, Clarence Darrow led the defence and Henry Sweet was acquitted in 1926.
question: Who will stand beside you when your next hard step turns rough?
key_contrast: One man had the right; it took an organisation to defend it.
